LVKE.|201 HOLY weeke.}}</noinclude>{{dropinitial|A|fl={{verse|chapter=22|verse=1}}}}ND {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 26, 1. Mr. 14, 1.''}}* {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ The PASSION according to S. Luke in these two chapters, is the Gospel at Masse vpon Tenebre wenesday.}}∷ the festiual day of the Azymes approched, vvhich is called Pasche: {{verse|chapter=22|verse=2}}† and the cheefe Priests and the Scribes sought hovv they might kil him: but they feared the people. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=3}}† And Satan entred into Iudas that vvas surnamed Iscariote, one of the Tvvelue. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=4}}† And he vvent, and talked vvith the cheefe Priests and the Magistrates, hovv he might betray him to them. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=5}}† And they vvere glad, and bargained to giue him money. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=6}}† And he promised. And he sought opportunitie to betray him apart from the multitudes.

{{verse|chapter=22|verse=7}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 26. 17. Mr. 14, 12.''}}* {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ MAVNDY Thursday.}}∷ And the day of the Azymes came, vvherein it vvas necessarie that the Pasche should be killed. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=8}}† And he sent Peter and Iohn, saying, Goe and prepare vs the Pasche, that vve may eate. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=9}}† But they said, VVhere vvilt thou that vve prepare it? {{verse|chapter=22|verse=10}}† And he said to them, Behold, as you enter into the citie, there shal meete you a man carying a pitcher of vvater: folovv him into the house into vvhich he entreth, {{verse|chapter=22|verse=11}}† and you shal say to the good man of the house, The Maister saith to thee, VVhere is the inne vvhere I may eate the Pasche vvith my Disciples? {{verse|chapter=22|verse=12}}† And he vvil shevv you a great refectorie adorned: and there prepare. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=13}}† And they going, found as he said to them, and prepared the Pasche.

{{verse|chapter=22|verse=14}}† And vvhen the houre was come, he sate dovvne, and the tvvelue Apostles vvith him. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=15}}† And he said to them, {{sup|‖}} VVith desire I haue desired to eate this Pasche vvith you before I suffer. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=16}}† For I say to you, that from this time I vvil not eate it, til it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=17}}† And {{sup|‖}} taking the chalice he gaue thankes, and said, Take and deuide among you, {{verse|chapter=22|verse=18}}† for I say to you, That I vvil not drinke of the generation of the vine, til the kingdom of God doe come.

{{verse|chapter=22|verse=19}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 26, 26. Mr. 14, 22. 1. Cor. 11, 24.''}}* And taking bread, he gaue thankes, and brake: and gaue to them, saying, {{sup|‖}} {{sc|This is my body {{sup|‖}} vvhich is given for yov}}. {{sup|‖}} Doe this {{sup|‖}} for a commemoration of me. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=20}}† In like maner the chalice also, after he had supped, saying, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ The Greeke is here so plaine, that there was very bloud in the chalice, shed for vs, that Beza saith it is a corruption in the greeke. See the Annota. vpon this place.}}∷ {{sc|This is the chalice {{sup|‖}} the nevv testament in my blovd, {{sup|‖}} vvhich shal be shed for yov}}.

{{verse|chapter=22|verse=21}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 26, 21. Mr. 14, 20. Io. 13, 18.''}}* But yet behold, the hand of him that betraieth me, is vvith me on the table. {{verse|chapter=22|verse=22}}† And the Sonne of man in deede<noinclude>{{rh||Cc|goeth}}</noinclude>
